additional_source_findings.finding: SKILL.md is read before leaf link or byte-limit validation
additional_source_findings.evidence: Current branch package calls (src / SKILL.md).is_file then read_text at lines32-34. Per-file symlink and size guards occur only later inside os.walk. Synthetic Path.read_text instrumentation confirmed a SKILL.md symlink target is read before InstallError. An oversized source SKILL.md is likewise read before the 2MiB guard. Reject the leaf via checked_path and validate size before reading; bound read size.

additional_source_findings.finding: Nested package members do not use generalized reparse checks
additional_source_findings.evidence: Current branch os.walk members use only p.is_symlink. On supported Windows Python3.11, junction/reparse directories can be non-symlinks. checked_path is only applied to the package root. Use checked_path on SKILL.md and every child before traversal/read/copy; add Windows junction rejection coverage. Python3.11 also lacks Path.is_junction; verify_release.regular and extraction ancestor checks use hasattr and therefore miss junction ancestors under that supported runtime.

review_summary: 15 AS3 and one EA2 are contextual false positives; E1 is not exfiltration but exposes actual baseline supply-chain trust weakness; both TT2 are legitimate operations with a demonstrated unchecked path boundary; all four AST4 are expected explicit invocations with ordinary execution trust preconditions. The baseline is not declared secure.
